info.title: [VGE-DZ-SS07] Cardfight!! Vanguard Special Series 07: Master Deckset -Michiru Hazama- ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
DZ-SS07/001EN
Demonic Jewel Dragon, Drajeweled
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[ACT](VC)[1/Turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1], and [Soul-Charge 2]. If all of the cards [Soul-Charge] have different grades, you may draw a card.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, [COST][Soul-Blast 4] cards with different grades], choose one of your opponent's vanguards, until end of turn, increase or decrease its [Power] to 1, and if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, this unit gets [Critical]+1. ([Power] at that time becomes 1, and can increase or decrease afterwards)

DZ-SS07/002EN
Demonic Stone Dragon, Jewelneel
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When this unit's attack hits a vanguard, [Soul-Charge 1].
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by a unit with "Drajeweled" in its card name, [Soul-Charge 1], and if your soul has three or more cards with different grades, draw a card.

DZ-SS07/003EN
Jewel Core Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Demonic Stone Dragon, Jewelneel", call this card to (RC).
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks or boosts, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of that battle. At the end of that battle, put this unit into soul. (This effect is mandatory)

DZ-SS07/004EN
Jewelias Dracokid
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

DZ-SS07/005EN
Demonic Jewel True Dragon, Drajeweled Ignis
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 4｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[CONT]:This card can only be ridden from a unit with "Drajeweled" in its card name.
[AUTO](VC):At the beginning of your battle phase, choose two cards from your drop, and put them into soul. Then, if your soul has four or more cards with different grades, all of your front row units get [Power]+15000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC):While you are paying the cost for this ability, you may [Soul-Blast] cards with "Drajeweled" in their card names from your soul as any grade from 0 to 4. When this unit attacks, [COST][Soul-Blast 5] cards with different grades], retire all of your opponent's back row rear-guards, and until end of turn, this unit gets [Critical]+1, and increase or decrease all of your opponent's front row units' [Power] to 0.

DZ-SS07/006EN
Demonic Jewel Dragon, Rystal Galer
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if you [Soul-Blast 4] or more cards at the same time for the cost of your vanguard's ability this turn, [COST][put a card from hand into soul], draw a card, choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it. (Usable only if you [Soul-Blast 4] or more at once)

DZ-SS07/007EN
Flower of Ruined Castle, Empousa
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]Front Row (RC):When you [Soul-Blast 4] or more at the same time for the cost of your vanguard's ability, if your unit did not [Stand] by a card's ability this turn, you may [Stand] this unit. If you [Stand] this unit, at the end of that turn, [COST][retire this unit], choose a grade 2 or greater unit card from your soul, and put it into hand. (The end of turn effect can only be used if you [Stand] this card by its effect)

DZ-SS07/008EN
Soul Severing Demonic Spear Knight, Zagan
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) during your main phase, you may [Soul-Charge 1]. Choose up to one grade 4 card from your hand, and reveal it. If you revealed a card, or you have a grade 4 or greater vanguard with "Drajeweled" in its card name, choose up to one card from your soul with a different card name from this unit and grade less than or equal to your vanguard, and call it to (RC). At the end of that turn, put that called unit into soul.
[CONT](RC):If you have a vanguard with "Drajeweled" in its card name, this unit gets "Boost".

DZ-SS07/009EN
Demonic Stone Dragon, Rockargour
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC)[1/Turn]:When this unit attacks a grade 3 or greater unit, if your soul has four or more cards with different grades, this unit gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](RC):When you [Soul-Blast 4] or more cards at the same time for the cost of your vanguard's ability, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and [Stand] this unit. (Usable only if you [Soul-Blast 4] or more at once)

DZ-SS07/010EN
Compositive Freaks
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](GC):If you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Drajeweled" in its card name, this unit gets [Shield]+5000.
[ACT](Drop):If you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Drajeweled" in its card name, [COST][bind this card], choose a grade 3 or greater card from your drop, and put it into soul.

DZ-SS07/011EN
Wise Demonic Lordling, Varpula
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When you [Soul-Blast 4] or more cards at the same time for the cost of your vanguard's ability, [COST][put this unit into soul], and draw a card. Then, choose up to one grade 4 card from your hand, and reveal it. If you revealed a card, or you have a grade 4 or greater vanguard with "Drajeweled" in its card name, choose one of your rear-guards, and if your rear-guards did not [Stand] by a card's ability this turn, [Stand] it.

DZ-SS07/012EN
Hoardslash Dracokid
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), [COST][Counter-Blast 1], look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to one grade 4 card with "Drajeweled" in its card name, reveal it and put it into hand, and shuffle the deck. If you did not reveal a card, choose up to one grade 4 card from your hand, reveal it, and if you revealed a card from hand, or have a grade 4 or greater vanguard with "Drajeweled" in its card name, draw a card.

DZ-SS07/013EN
Repelled Malice Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle. If your hand has two or more cards, choose a card from your hand, and discard it.

DZ-SS07/014EN
Hades Dragon Deity of Resentment, Gallmageheld
Trigger Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - You get "During your turn, all of your vanguards get [Power]+10000/[Critical]+1" until end of this fight!

DZ-SS07/015EN
Connected Rampage, Clenn
Trigger Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical]+1 until end of turn! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn!)

DZ-SS07/016EN
Insane Researcher
Trigger Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
(When revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn!)

DZ-SS07/017EN
Wire-pull Subjugater
Trigger Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, all of your front row units get [Power]+10000 until end of turn!)

DZ-SS07/018EN
Caper Companion
Trigger Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(You may only have up to four [Heal] in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn! Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)

DZ-SS07/019EN
Shroud in Darkness
Normal Order｜ -｜ Grade 3｜ Power ｜ Shield
Regalis Piece (You may only have one Regalis Piece in your deck, and use it a total of one time in a fight)
If you did not ride from the ride deck this turn, this ability can be played without paying the cost.
Play this with [COST][Counter-Blast 1]!
Choose up to two non-sentinel normal units with different card names and the sum of their grades being less than or equal to your vanguard from your drop, and call them to (RC). If you called one or less cards, put this card into soul.

DZ-SS07/020EN
Elementaria Sanctitude
Blitz Order｜ -｜ Grade 1｜ Power ｜ Shield
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[CONT]:You may only have one "Elementaria Sanctitude" in a deck.
Play this with [COST][discard a card from hand] if you do not have any cards in your crest zone other than "Energy Generator"!
If your opponent's crest zone has a card other than "Energy Generator", this ability can be played without paying the cost.
Choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle. Remove this card.
